besluite.fout: A lesson as the subject that 'kyk na' copies English ('the rest of this lesson looks at').
besluite.rede: Making 'ons' the subject is the natural Afrikaans and says the same thing.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Die blou is water' and 'dit bedek ...' each have their own subject and verb.

besluite.fout: 'Die meeste van' with a single uncountable surface copies English 'most of'.
besluite.rede: 'Die grootste deel van' is the natural Afrikaans for one surface and keeps the same quantity (more than half).

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Al hierdie water is sout' and 'jy kan dit nie drink nie' are two sentences with their own subject and verb.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Afrika is 'n kontinent' and 'Suid-Afrika lê ...' each have their own subject and verb.

besluite.fout: 'daarom' reads first as 'therefore', so a Grade 4 reader stumbles; the AWS comma between two full clauses is also missing.
besluite.rede: Naming the island the sentence already refers to removes the misreading without adding a fact, and the comma follows the AWS.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'n Eiland is ...' and 'n meer is ...' are two sentences each with subject and verb, so the house rule requires the comma.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'maar' joining two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Jy kan lug nie sien nie' and 'jy voel dit ...' each have their own subject and verb.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Nêrens hou dit skielik op nie' and 'daar is geen boonste rand nie' are two full sentences.

besluite.fout: 'haal asem met die lug' is wooden Afrikaans.
besluite.rede: The fault is real, but in the proposal 'in hierdie dun laag in' reads as the circumposition 'into this thin layer', so a Grade 4 reader can take it as breathing air into the layer; the sentence needs another fix.

besluite.fout: 'maak' is the wrong verb: land, water and air do not make places.
besluite.rede: 'vorm' is the right verb for the action and keeps the meaning, like Drico's kept 'maak' correction.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Die Aarde het ... habitatte' and 'daarom lewe daar baie soorte dinge' each have their own subject and verb.

besluite.fout: The relative clause 'wat jy kan sien en aanraak' can attach to 'iets' instead of to 'die buitekant'.
besluite.rede: The ambiguity is real, but this is a glossary definition and the change rewords it beyond spelling or grammar, so only the writer may change it.
